# LGDA FC

> LGDA is a girls' and women's football club based in Watford, Hertfordshire. We provide football in a safe and friendly environment for female players of all backgrounds and abilities, including those who have never played before. The club was formed in 2019, is an FA Accredited club, and plays in the Hertfordshire Girls Football Partnership League.

Girls' teams train on Tuesdays and Thursdays and play matches on Saturdays. Women's teams train on Tuesdays and play on Sundays. Home matches are at Sun Postal Sports & Social Club, Bellmount Wood Ave, Watford, WD17 3BN. Training venues change over the winter, so check the calendar.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://lgda.co.uk/): training and match days, latest news, sponsors
- [About](https://lgda.co.uk/about): the club's approach, match and training venues, safeguarding and policies
- [Calendar](https://lgda.co.uk/calendar): training and match dates, venues, half terms and key dates for the season
